text:
Type: striped pop-up storage basket with lid
Use: storing toys, laundry, blankets or clutter; bedroom, children's room, living room
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: polyester fabric over a flexible spiral wire frame, fabric lid, loop handles
Colors: black and white stripes, bright yellow lid and handles
Shape: tall round drum with soft collapsible sides, fitted lid with a strap pull, side loop handle, light and easy to move
Feel: playful, cheerful, casual, practical
Goes with: white walls, black accents, yellow or bold primary colors; playful Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: FLYTTBAR
product.description: Colourful, freestanding basket with room for everything from toys and clothes to important personal items.
